suno.estilo: Night hot-spring lullaby: tender, sleepy, safe, water that makes you forget. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. Lead vocal: adult female mezzo-soprano, pure airy tone, light vibrato, invented language sung with Spanish and Latin vowels. The voice is close and almost whispered. Slow arpeggiated guitar, plucked psaltery, sustained low cello, softly bowed singing bowls. No percussion. D minor opening into F major, 50 BPM in 6/8 (dotted quarter), gentle rocking. Form: guitar intro, two soft verses, humming section, guitar outro.
